literal: Wife (acc.) who fears, next-world man-without, action capability greatness attaining is-not.
translation: The man who fears his wife lacks the rewards of the next world, and his capability in action will never attain greatness.
modern: தன் மனைவிக்கு அஞ்சுகின்ற, மறுமைப் பயன் இல்லாதவனுடைய செயல் திறம் எந்தப் பெருமையையும் அடையாது.
explanation: This couplet describes the consequences of a man fearing his wife. The phrase 'மறுமை இலாளன்' (man without a next world) implies that by yielding to fear, he fails to perform righteous duties that secure future rewards. Consequently, his 'வினை ஆண்மை' (manliness or capability in action) becomes fruitless. Even if he undertakes great tasks, his efforts will lack 'வீறு' (splendor or greatness) because his fundamental lack of courage undermines his achievements.
